finding_key: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts::slides text-body style validation is stricter than the slides reader, so a get → edit → put round-trip of an existing deck can now 400
evidence: Verified in packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts: assertValidTextBodyBlocks → assertValidBlockStyle throws 400 on `lineHeight: null` / unknown alignment for slide text bodies, while the slides GET path (readSlidesRoot) returns those bodies verbatim with no normalizer — the code's own comments confirm "there is no attribute codec to normalize them on read", and the rest-api.md change guarantees GET→PUT losslessness only "for docs bodies". Since the pre-change validator checked only structure, decks can already hold such values, so an unmodified GET→PUT round-trip can 400 on data the caller never touched. Real, but scoped to decks already holding invalid style values, hence minor.
